description: Normative mobile scope for MOB-002. Dispositions: required (same behavior), equivalent (same outcome through a native mechanism), degraded (reduced outcome accepted by the product owner), unavailable, not-applicable.

FILENAME-GENERATION-001.adaptation: MOB-008 context values; path mode resolves beneath the app's storage or the XerahS collection.

POST-CAPTURE-ACTIONS-001.adaptation: Same engine, order, and result model. Per-action dispositions are listed in actions as [android, ios]. Selection windows are native sheets; save-as uses the document picker; reveal opens the item in the system gallery or Files app; file-clipboard shares the file; ocr and qr-scan use on-device recognition.

REGION-CAPTURE-001.adaptation: Android: MOB-004 capture, then region selection over the captured frame. iOS: MOB-005 import, then region selection over the imported image; on-demand capture of other apps is not possible on iOS. Overlay-specific requirements (RC-005, RC-011 window snapping, RC-013 cursor) are not-applicable; mapping, confirmation, cancellation, keyboard, accessibility, and diagnostics apply.

EDITOR-SESSION-001.adaptation: MOB-007 touch mapping; export pixels unchanged.

EDITOR-ANNOTATIONS-001.adaptation: Touch-first tool palette; Apple Pencil and stylus pressure MAY refine freehand strokes without changing stored geometry semantics.

EDITOR-EFFECTS-001.adaptation: Effect parameters use native controls; output pixels follow the effect contracts.

EDITOR-CANVAS-001.adaptation: Pinch and pan change only the viewport (MOB-007).

EDITOR-OUTPUT-ACTIONS-001.adaptation: Outputs route through MOB-009 saving and the system share sheet.

EDITOR-SETTINGS-001.adaptation: Keyboard shortcuts apply only with an attached hardware keyboard.

EDITOR-UTILITIES-001.adaptation: Utilities that need desktop screen access are not-applicable; the others use native controls.

SETTINGS-CATALOG-001.adaptation: MOB-016 shared schema with mobile-applicable subset shown.

WORKFLOW-CATALOG-001.adaptation: Workflows triggered by hotkeys or desktop capture modes are not-applicable (MOB-017); per-row mobile dispositions are required before this capability activates on mobile.

INTERFACE-CATALOG-001.adaptation: Tray, CLI, MCP, and shell surfaces are not-applicable; share sheet, intents, App Intents, and Shortcuts are the mobile interfaces (MOB-017).

CORE-PLATFORM-001.adaptation: CORE requirements apply except desktop-only surfaces listed in MOB-017 and Linux editions (CORE-033 to CORE-037).

COMPATIBILITY-CATALOG-001.adaptation: Formats read or written on mobile follow their compatibility contracts (MOB-016).
